@router.get("/api/v1/tenants/schemas/{schema_name}/tables/summary")
def get_schema_tables_summary(
    schema_name: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)

corrected_code:
@router.get("/api/v1/tenants/schemas/{schema_name}/tables/summary")
def get_schema_tables_summary(
    schema_name: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    if current_user.tenant_schema != schema_name:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Unauthorized to inspect target schema storage metrics")
    query = text("""
        SELECT table_name, pg_total_relation_size(quote_ident(table_schema) || '.' || quote_ident(table_name)) as bytes
        FROM information_schema.tables
        WHERE table_schema = :schema
    """)
    rows = db.execute(query, {"schema": schema_name}).fetchall()
    return [{"table": r[0], "size_bytes": r[1]} for r in rows]
